common.fallback: If the button doesn't work, paste this link into your browser:
common.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email.
common.footer: Sent to {email} by glot, open source i18n for SaaS. This is an account email: you can't unsubscribe from it.
common.footer_optional: Sent to {email} by glot. You get this because job notifications are on in your account settings.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address
verify.body: Confirm that {email} is your address to secure your glot account. The link expires in 48 hours.

reset.subject: Reset your glot password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password of your glot account. The link works once and expires in 1 hour. Resetting signs you out everywhere.

password_changed.subject: Your glot password was changed
password_changed.body: The password of your glot account was just changed. If this wasn't you, reset it now and check your API tokens.

email_changed.subject: Your glot email address was changed
email_changed.body: The email address of your glot account was changed to {new_email}. If this wasn't you, reset your password now.

job_done.subject: Translation finished in {project}
job_done.body: Your translation job in {project} is done: {done} of {total} strings processed, cost {cost} USD.

job_failed.subject: Translation failed in {project}
job_failed.body: Your translation job in {project} failed after {done} of {total} strings: {error}
